name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px focus ring with a 2px offset to every interactive element that gets keyboard focus. This keeps the ring clearly visible while reducing overlap with adjacent elements, improving readability for users who rely on keyboard navigation. The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence than a thicker ring, but it prevents confusion in dense layouts where rings might collide.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring with 2px offset still risks failing 4.5:1 contrast on dark backgrounds. Better alternative: Use a 3px ring with 3px offset—it meets contrast on both light and dark themes. Settle it by testing the exact colors in WCAG’s contrast checker.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px focus ring with a 3px offset on every interactive element. It meets 4.5:1 contrast on both light and dark backgrounds, ensuring visibility for all users. The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence, but that’s acceptable because clarity and compliance outweigh aesthetic impact. This decision keeps EXCAVA usable by everyone, including those with low vision or relying on keyboard navigation.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 3px ring with 3px offset shrinks to 2.6px visible width on 1.25x zoom—failing 4.5:1 on dark gray (#111) backgrounds. Better alternative: Use a 4px ring with 1px offset; it stays above 4.5:1 even at 1.5x zoom. Settle it by testing the exact colors in WCAG’s contrast checker at 100%, 125%, and 150% zoom.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship a **4px solid focus ring in #0078D4 with 1px outer offset** on all interactive elements; verify WCAG 4.5:1 contrast at 100%, 125%, and 150% zoom in both light/dark themes. Owner: Ramp.
